raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "be admin on"
      role subject "Hana"
      role object "the Grafana org"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be admin on"
      role subject "Joaquín"
      role object "the Grafana org"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "share"
    role subject "Hana and Joaquín"
    role object "one account"
    polarity affirmed
  end
